value: card
Standing rules for every D screen

1. One spine, both paths: AA users arrive prefilled and tagged AA-fed, CAS users with holdings tagged CAS-verified, manual users with empty fields; no screen is bypassed on any path; order D01, D08, D09, D05, D06, D02, D03, D04, D07, D10
2. One question per screen for numbers; taps may auto-advance; list items get a list screen plus a detail screen per item type; every instance is its own screen ID with a template tag

3. Band rule: every band question shows a visible exact input; a tapped band prefills the exact field with the midpoint; exact removes the approx tag; fixed bands per field from the M2 tables 9.1 to 9.5 where a table exists, else Rs ___ placeholder chips; dynamic bands are shelved until the data flywheel exists; each field is exact-first or band-first

4. Readback and units: every amount shows a readback in words, a per-month or per-year toggle where either applies, L and Cr multipliers and the numeric keypad; plausibility checks against the reveal prompt a check, never a block
5. Hesitation detection: at 45 seconds a warm line (D11a), at 90 seconds the why-this-matters line (D11b), at 120 seconds or on a second return the skip offer (D11c); copy slots only

6. Tri-state fields: value, explicit none, not sure; None chips set explicit none; Not sure yet, skip sets not sure; not sure is never stored as zero; blindspot and concern copy fires on explicit none only; not sure produces a verify action

7. Gate and sharpen: the plan builds when every field the React reads is a value (exact or band) or explicit none; a not-sure field blocks the build and is asked for as a quick range on D13, never filled from an assumption; sharpen fields appear inside the plan section they improve as Sharpen this links that reopen the single screen and re-run

8. Capture ladder: under the exact input and the bands, the lower-friction sources for that item, in order where they apply: AA, CAS upload, guided lookup, document to the Vault, then Not sure yet, skip; no partner ask anywhere

9. Source and precision tags on every field: source aa, cas or manual, plus default accepted for the one default the user takes on screen (D07b work-optional age 60); precision exact, approx or unknown; D10 and every G screen show them; a manual override locks the field against AA refresh
10. Section micro-feedback: after the last screen of each spine section, one card in the adviser voice, chosen by the answers, no numbers (D12a to D12h); copy slots only
11. Endowed progress: the ring starts at 20 percent after the reveal, weighted gate fields first; minutes are about N minutes
12. Exit from any D screen: autosave, then O03 When will you finish; the chosen time replaces the first scheduled nudge and the standard ladder follows
13. Events and compliance flags on every screen (appendices D and G)
